articles.title: Britain's New 'Be Ready' Guide: How to Cope for 72 Hours on Your Own
articles.summary: Britain has launched a 'Be Ready' guide to help families cope on their own for 72 hours in an emergency, and experts say the aim is calm, practical advice, not fear.

articles.title: South Africa's ANC Suffers Its Worst Election Result Ever
articles.summary: South Africa's governing ANC has recorded its worst-ever local election result, winning a majority in just one of nine provinces, and now faces two weeks of coalition talks.

articles.title: Norway Loses Its World Juniors Spot to Russia, but the Story Isn't Over
articles.summary: Norway says it has been bumped from the world junior hockey championships to make room for Russia, but Canada may bar the Russian team, so Norway's hopes are still alive.
